title: Mohamed Siddique — blooming-flowers card: Design you can feel
note: A 13-second looping video: a painterly landscape border frames a central cream card, thin green stems sprout upward, small flowers bloom across it, then fade away, leaving the card blank before the loop repeats. Caption: Experimenting with different styles. Let's see what blooms! Her steal: the blooming-stems animation as a Play piece or reel device, and the copy line — nothing asks for attention, yet every stitch is considered — as a design-philosophy statement. Also added to her video-editing things-to-try list.
